message.content:
Based on my search, I can estimate how many times the average human blinks in a lifetime. Let me break this down step by step.

## Key Statistics from Research

**Blink Rate:**
- The average adult blinks about **14-20 times per minute** depending on the source
- Cleveland Clinic reports 14-17 times per minute
- All About Vision reports 15 times per minute for teens/adults
- Science Times reports 10-20 times per minute

**Daily Blink Count:**
- At 15 blinks/minute × 1,440 minutes/day = **21,600 blinks per day** (All About Vision, assuming awake all day)
- More realistically, accounting for 8 hours of sleep (16 hours awake): 15 × 60 × 16 = **14,400 blinks per day**
- Cleveland Clinic estimates 13,440-16,320 blinks per day (16 hours awake)

**Annual Blink Count:**
- All About Vision: ~**7.8 million blinks per year**

## Lifetime Estimate

Using these figures with an average global lifespan of approximately **72-80 years**:

| Source | Calculation | Lifetime Estimate |
|--------|-------------|-------------------|
| All About Vision | 7.8 million/year × ~80 years | **621.5 million** |
| Conservative (14-17 bpm, 16 hrs awake, 72 years) | ~14,000/day × 365 × 72 | **~368 million** |
| Moderate (15 bpm, 16 hrs awake, 80 years) | 14,400/day × 365 × 80 | **~420 million** |
| Higher estimate (20 bpm, 16 hrs awake, 80 years) | 19,200/day × 365 × 80 | **~561 million** |

## My Best Estimate

Taking the middle ground with reasonable assumptions:
- **15 blinks per minute**
- **16 hours awake per day** (8 hours sleep)
- **75-year average lifespan** (global average between 72-80)

**Calculation:**
- 15 blinks/min × 60 min/hour × 16 hours/day = **14,400 blinks/day**
- 14,400 × 365.25 days/year = **~5.26 million blinks/year**
- 5.26 million × 75 years = **~394 million blinks in a lifetime**

However, if we use the higher estimate that doesn't reduce for sleep (as some sources calculate), or use a longer lifespan:
- 21,600 blinks/day × 365 × 80 years = **~631 million**

## Conclusion

The average human blinks approximately **400 to 650 million times in a lifetime**, with a commonly cited figure around **500 million** as a reasonable middle estimate. The variation depends on:
- Actual blink rate (varies by activity, screen time, health)
- Hours of sleep per day
- Lifespan
- Individual differences

All About Vision's estimate of **621.5 million** for a lifetime is one of the more frequently cited figures from eye care professionals.

Sources:
1. https://www.allaboutvision.com/eye-care/eye-anatomy/how-many-times-we-blink-per-day/
2. https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/articles/blinking
3. https://www.sciencetimes.com/articles/47349/20231128/why-blink-what-eyes-frequency-considered-normal.htm
4. https://wellwisp.com/how-many-times-should-you-blink-per-minute/
5. https://www.lens.com/questions-answered/how-many-blinks-does-the-average-person-do-a-day/
6. https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12280v2
7. https://www.londonvisionclinic.com/blink-and-youll-feel-better/
8. https://www.thedailyjagran.com/did-you-know/do-you-know-how-many-times-an-average-person-blinks-per-day-10263091
